en: Black‑and‑white photographic portrait of an African woman wearing a patterned headscarf and a fringed, embroidered shawl over her clothing. She faces the camera and smiles slightly. At the bottom of the image there is small printed text, likely the title and publisher's code, and a separate small number in a white box at the lower right corner that appears to be a catalog or series number.
